Jonas,

Thanks for taking this on. For the upcoming SOC 2 Type II review of NimbleApps, our reviewer team needs a short access window to the Trust Portal to pull artifacts and confirm control evidence that supports the period ending 2026-03-31. Specifically we need:

If possible, please provide the preferred reviewer emails and an initial proposed window. We can accommodate on-prem reviewers but prefer the Trust Portal session. Also list any artifacts you anticipate will be packaged so we can allocate time to review them.
